full_judgment: 4. The case of the plaintiff inter alia is that the land mentioned in the schedule of plaint originally belonged to Mongshe Mogh appertaining to Khatian No. 290 of Golabari Mouza being Plot No. 4332 measuring 47 decimals of land and that the land in question was purchased by the plaintiff by starting mutation case No. 33 of 1999 which was approved by the Deputy Commissioner, Khagrachari on 27-12-1999. Since then the plaintiff was in possession of the suit land upon paying rent year to year to the Government. All on a sudden the defendant forcibly entered the suit land on 22-12-2007 and dispossessed the plaintiff from 37 decimals of land out of 47 decimals. Thereafter, defendant planted banana garden on 37 decimals of land. Having heard the news the plaintiff asked the defendant in presence of local pourashava commissioner to handover the possession of 37 decimals of land to the petitioner. The defendant did not pay heed to any word of the plaintiff. Hence, the plaintiff filed this case against the petitioner for restoration of possession and declaration of title in the suit land.
